infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond needs camera access for profile photos and wellness check-ins
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond needs photo library access to upload profile pictures
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond needs microphone access for video calls with therapists
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond uses Bluetooth to connect to your Bold Band and sync health data.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to your Bold Band.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond reads health data you choose to share from Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Bold & Beyond writes steps, heart rate, sleep, SpO2, stress, temperature and ECG data to Apple Health.
